promotion_review.judgment: Supports provisional adoption of the frozen global classic-Saw source correction, subject to exact production integration and an explicit sample-rate convention. No uniform-metric or unique-architecture requirement is imposed.
promotion_review.evidence: Every original note/offset/slope alias-window proxy RMS improves, including69/76/81/84. Excluding91 preserves the improvement. Together with LP12 harmonic and held-note84 energy improvements and independent AirLead improvement, this is more than a single fitted-window gain.
promotion_review.counterevidence: LP24 harmonic-ratio regressions, increased broad dry log-spectral errors and SoJuno/Vangelead wet log-error regressions remain. They limit the claim and should not be averaged away or called inaudible without listening evidence.
promotion_review.concrete_remaining_integration_risk: The prototype defines support in four engine samples at44100Hz. Shipping Engine runs at the host sample rate. Blindly using the same four host samples at48000/96000 changes support from90.70us to83.33/41.67us and shifts the learned spectral shaping. This needs an explicit reference-rate versus host-rate convention and a bounded48/96k source/main-harmonic check during integration; no new coefficient fit is needed.
promotion_review.not_required: No additional architecture identification, firmware recovery, broader coefficient search or requirement that every benchmark metric improve.
promotion_review.scope: Engineering judgment from frozen outputs, not an audibility or whole-instrument-equivalence claim.
